upstream_footprint.tags_note: The way is not named, but carries building=yes, wood material, wood roof and the Cunningham Cabin Wikidata identifier.

placement.draft_policy: Use the upstream way centroid and bearing for local preview only. Fit the measured HABS wall envelope inside the mapped roof/footprint envelope and terrain-snap the model origin.
placement.production_gate: Refresh or explicitly add OSM way 106472595 to the repository building extract, then confirm its centroid within 3 m, long-axis bearing within 5 degrees and envelope within 0.75 m of orthophoto or classified LiDAR. Never place from the tourism node or parking coordinates.

recognition_contract.lod0: Two distinct log pens, genuinely open breezeway, common shallow sod-covered gable roof, saddle-V log ends and source-backed openings.
recognition_contract.lod1: Retain two pen masses, open breezeway and the common low gable/sod silhouette; simplify individual logs.
recognition_contract.lod2: Retain the open central void and low continuous roof silhouette; no opening or log relief.

constraints: Render fixed orthographic targets from approved geometry before image-assisted surfacing.
Project only onto opaque exterior faces; the breezeway must remain a geometric opening with normal scene depth and lighting.
Use only sources positively identified as Cunningham Cabin/HABS WY-25.
Preserve registered silhouette, log courses, saddle-V corners, roof pitch and openings.
Exclude landscape, sky, people, signs, fences, baked shadows, black rectangles and featureless painted door or window voids.
Do not synthesize dimensions, roof topology, openings or missing elevations.
projection.fallback: Use a compact tileable log/chinking and sod/board atlas if a clean registered projection cannot pass the visual gate.

quarantine_gates.fail_when: The HABS WY-25 record, all five measured sheets and at least two same-building photographic elevations are unavailable, unidentified or lack usable rights metadata.
The upstream footprint cannot be brought into the local extract or disagrees with orthophoto/LiDAR by more than the production placement tolerance.
The two pens, 10 ft 2 in open breezeway, common low gable roof, measured envelope or saddle-V corners are absent or outside documented tolerances.
The breezeway reads as a painted black rectangle, projection edges drift, unverified openings are added, the sod roof loses its low continuous silhouette, or the building floats above terrain.
Any LOD, primitive, texture residency or one-active-LOD budget is exceeded.

production_blockers: The current repository building extract does not contain upstream OSM way 106472595.
Final terrain height and footprint orientation still require orthophoto or LiDAR confirmation.
